N1: Every morning Mei's grandmother cuts a notch in a bamboo stick, and every morning the sky stays empty.
N2: The wells of Bamboo Ridge Village are almost dry, the rice seedlings are turning yellow, and the rain-asking at the shrine has failed.
N3: Then someone remembers the old story of the dragon of Black Pool, high on the mountain.
N4: Mei, who freezes whenever she has to speak up, is the only one who says, "I'll go."
N5: With her chatty little brother in yellow rain boots, a know-it-all classmate who is secretly afraid of heights, and a patient water buffalo, she climbs through bamboo, over a rope bridge and into the clouds.
N6: At the top she finds a dragon who is kind, polite and absolutely terrified of his own thunder.
N7: Can a girl who cannot raise her voice help a dragon who will not raise his?
